product_metadata.title: WJHGJTHY Microfiber Bathroom Rugs（16"×24" Dark Gray） Non Slip Mat Ultra Soft Shaggy and Absorbent Machine Washable Thick Plush Bath Rug for Bathroom
features: SOFT and FLUFFY: The bath rug is constructed with thick upgraded and ultra high-density polyester microfiber shags which can make the mat softer and more fluffy. The soft pile has been reinforced to avoid shedding and help soothe tried feet.

SUPER ABSORBENT: The microfiber shag bath mat is much more absorbent than other materials. It can quickly and efficiently absorb dripping water while you’re stepping out of the bath, shower, or getting ready by the sink. Owing to the fluffy piles, moisture evaporates fast, making the rugs dry rapidly.

NON SLIP RUBBER BACKING: This bathroom mat features TPR rubber backing which is non-slip and durable for long lasting use. This anti-skid backing helps keeping the mat firmly in place, that it won’t shift or skid, keeping you more safe and cozy. Please place the rug on CLEAN and DRY FLOOR only. Water or dust under rug can cause it to slip. Keep bottom of rug dry and clean.

MACHINE WASHABLE: The bathroom rug is super easy to clean. Machine wash in cold water with mild detergent. Do not use chlorine or bleach. Tumble dry on low heat or lay to air dry, the color will not fade with continual uses.

MULTIPLE USES: The bath mat can be widely used in various occasions, such as bathroom, living room, study room, hallway, bedroom, balcony, bathtub side. Please choose one of your favorite colors to match the home decoration perfectly.
